question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A room where dead bodies are kept until burial
solution:
The correct answer is **mortuary. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mortuary **refers to a place where the** dead body is used to be kept before cremation.**

 
 
• **​Example: ***All the dead bodies from the accident spot have been kept at the mortuary.​*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **Sanatorium **refers to a place where** people used to receive treatment and care for their prolonged illnesses.**

 
 
• **​Example- ***During the pandemic, the sanatoriums used to get overcrowded with patients.*
 
 
 
• **Museum **refers to a place where** objects of importance are preserved and kept for public display.**
 
 
• **​Example: ***A **Museum is a place of wonder where one can study the rich history of one's country.*
 
 
 
• **Safari **refers to an expedition** to watch animals in their natural habitat.**
 
 
• **​Example: ***I am planning to embark on a wild life safari.*
